seo.title: Custom business software — replace spreadsheets with one system
seo.description: Sales, stock, operations and reporting in one system designed around how your business works. Built and supported by Atlaxys.

hero.title: Replace the spreadsheets with one system that fits your business.
hero.lead: Sales, stock, operations, field teams and reporting — in one place, designed around how your team actually works, in French, Arabic or English.
bullets: Designed with your team, not for an org chart
Your existing data migrated for you
Web, desktop or mobile — even offline
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like to discuss business software for my company.

problem.title: The spreadsheet ceiling
points: Nobody trusts the numbers because every team has its own file
Stock, orders and invoices never quite match
Only one person knows how the process really works
Off-the-shelf software forces you to change how you work

solution.title: One system, built around your workflow
solution.text: We map how your business runs today, then build the software that removes double entry and gives everyone the same live information.

points.title: Your workflow
points.text: Screens and rules designed around your real process.

points.title: Roles and permissions
points.text: Everyone sees what they need — nothing more.

points.title: Live reports
points.text: The numbers managers check every morning, always up to date.

points.title: Integrations
points.text: Accounting, payments, e-commerce and messaging connected.

items.title: One version of the truth
items.text: Every team works from the same data.

items.title: Less typing, fewer errors
items.text: Data entered once and reused everywhere.

items.title: Software you own
items.text: No per-user licences that grow with your team.

proof.title: Built on real products
proof.text: We also build business software products of our own, such as:

steps.title: Visit and mapping
steps.text: We see how your team works today.

steps.title: Written scope
steps.text: Screens, rules, integrations and a phased estimate.

steps.title: Build in iterations
steps.text: Working software to test every two weeks.

steps.title: Migration and training
steps.text: Your data moved over and your team onboarded.

items.question: Can you import our existing Excel data?
items.answer: Yes. Data migration is planned as part of the project, with checks against your own totals.

items.question: Can it work without internet?
items.answer: Yes, when needed — desktop and mobile apps can work offline and sync later.

items.question: Who maintains the system?
items.answer: We offer maintenance and support plans, or a documented handover to your own team.
